what_it_does: This work tackles the problem of running large language models (LLMs) with a billion parameters on edge devices—phones, IoT sensors, devices with tight power budgets. The key challenge is that storing and computing with the model's parameters (its numerical weights) normally requires a lot of energy. The approach uses extreme quantization: instead of storing weights as full-precision numbers, they use only 1 or 2 bits per weight (binary or ternary weights). The specialized processor includes custom compute units built for this low-precision arithmetic and exploits sparsity—skipping unimportant numbers—to reduce memory bandwidth demands.
